dish.title: Cuban Picadillo with Green Olives, Capers, and Raisins over White Rice
dish.description: Ground beef browned and simmered with a sofrito of onion, green bell pepper, and garlic, plus tomato sauce, cumin, oregano, bay leaf, green olives, capers, and raisins until thick and savory-sweet. Served over white rice.

recipe_version.title: Cuban Picadillo with Green Olives, Capers, and Raisins over White Rice
recipe_version.description: Ground beef browned and simmered with a sofrito of onion, green bell pepper, and garlic, plus tomato sauce, cumin, oregano, bay leaf, green olives, capers, and raisins until thick and savory-sweet. Served over white rice.

ingredients.name: canned tomato sauce
ingredients.display_name: tomato sauce (one 8-oz can) whose label lists tomatoes and salt only

ingredients.name: pimiento-stuffed green olives
ingredients.display_name: pimiento-stuffed green olives whose label lists olives, pimiento, water, salt, and vinegar only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Finely chop the onion and green pepper, mince the garlic, halve the olives, and drain the capers.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes. The covered cooking and rest run inside steps 3 to 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned with no pink, about 7 minutes. Spoon off all but about 1 tbsp of the fat.

steps.title: Cook the sofrito
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Add the onion and green pepper and cook, stirring, until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, and oregano and stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Stir in the tomato sauce, 1/2 cup water, the bay leaf, raisins, 1 tsp salt, and the pepper. Bring to a simmer, about 1 minute, cover partly, and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the olives and capers and simmer uncovered until thick, about 3 minutes. Remove the bay leaf.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice and spoon the picadillo alongside or over it.

scaling_notes.1: A quarter of everything in an 8-inch skillet; a quarter of the rice and water in a 1-quart saucepan.
scaling_notes.2: Half of everything in a 10-inch skillet; half the rice in a 1-quart saucepan.
do_not_scale: browning: brown the beef in a single layer; for larger batches brown it in two batches

coverage_contribution: A quick ground-beef weeknight dinner. Cuba is in the catalog only as an all-day slow-cooker ropa vieja and a sandwich; this is about 45 minutes.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with slow-cooker-ropa-vieja: ground beef simmered about 15 minutes, not shredded flank braised for hours. Compared with south-african-bobotie: no curry spices and no baked egg custard topping, though both use raisins. Compared with turkey-sloppy-joes: beef with olives, capers, and raisins over rice, not a sweet sauce on buns. Compared with cottage-pie: a skillet hash over rice, not a potato-topped bake.
not_duplicate_of: No potatoes, so it does not repeat the cottage pie's meat-and-potato idea.
